title: A Cipher for the Verdict
premise: Retired detective Casper Pemberton, now barely keeping his bookshop afloat, is handed the diary of missing court clerk Maren Voss by her desperate sister. The entries continue past the date of her disappearance, written in a cipher that mirrors an old accounting ledger hidden in the shop's own shelves — a ledger implicating a judge, a fixer, and the trial set to begin in ten days. As Casper decodes it, he realizes Maren faked her disappearance to survive and is alive but hunted, forcing him to choose between exposing the truth that will destroy his oldest friend's career or letting a killer walk free at trial. In the end, Casper publishes the decoded ledger through the testimony of a surprise witness, saves Maren from the fixer's final attempt to silence her, and accepts that truth cost him his last tie to the force — but earned him a new kind of belonging with the sister who helped him finish what the police abandoned.
about_author: Juniper Underhill spent fifteen years as a small-town court reporter before turning to fiction, giving her mysteries an insider's ear for the quiet corruptions of ordinary institutions. She writes from a converted chapel in the Cotswolds, where she keeps a shelf of unsolved cases that inspire her plots.

chapters.title: The Entry After the End
chapters.summary: Casper Pemberton's POV. A rainy Tuesday brings Nora Voss to the failing bookshop with her sister Maren's diary, which contains dated entries continuing three weeks past Maren's disappearance. Casper recognizes the shifted-letter cipher from an old case and finds the first decoded line names Judge Aldous Crane — the presiding judge in next month's bribery trial. Emotional beat: reluctant reawakening; the thrill of the hunt pulling him out of grief and stagnation.

chapters.title: Ledger in Plain Sight
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, with one interlude from Maren's diary voice. Decoding reveals the cipher keys off a Victorian accounting ledger Casper unknowingly shelved years ago — meaning someone planted it for him, or Maren once visited the shop. He traces payments through Crane to fixer Daniel Reeve, while a break-in at the shop signals they're being watched. Emotional beat: mounting dread as the puzzle turns personal.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. The trail exposes that Casper's former partner, DI Ruth Calloway, buried Maren's case under pressure from Reeve — her career and pension at stake. Confronting her, Casper must decide whether to protect the friend who taught him everything or follow the ledger to its end. Meanwhile Reeve offers Casper money and silence. Emotional beat: the theme crystallizes — loyalty versus truth, survival versus integrity.

chapters.title: Verdict by Cipher
chapters.summary: Alternating POV: Casper and Maren, revealed alive and hiding in plain sight as the shop's new 'temporary' clerk. At trial's opening, Casper enters the decoded ledger through Maren herself, who testifies from the gallery; Reeve attempts to silence her and is arrested mid-hearing when Ruth, choosing truth at last, corroborates the evidence. Crane resigns under investigation. Emotional beat: catharsis and belonging — Casper loses the force's approval but gains a partner, a purpose, and a reason to keep the shop's lights on.
